observed_steps: A new Revision was created through the public resource API against a persistent SQLite database.
The Gateway was restarted with a provider endpoint that was intentionally unavailable; prepare returned indexing and the worker persisted failed/unavailable.
The faulty Gateway was stopped and the Gateway was restarted with the real configured provider.
The same failed Revision was retried through prepare; the worker completed and persisted ready.

observations.zero_hit: not part of this controlled provider-outage run

limitations: Timeout-partial and zero-hit rows remain separate unexecuted sub-scenarios for the strict Gate 8 artifact.
